# Round 5, the optional sets after R2 (docs/gpu-experiments/05-final/02-local-gpu-split.md), if the minutes
# allow: the finals with the batch constant 4 (A2: into the default only if it wins both clocks), and the
# finals with --argmax-slices 8 (after R5's DECIDE). Each block is R2's A form at 30, 31, 32 and 29.
--layers 27 --head --iters 30 --final --runtime-flags=-DGEMV_BATCH=4 compare table continue    # batch 4
--layers 27 --head --iters 31 --final --runtime-flags=-DGEMV_BATCH=4 compare table continue
--layers 27 --head --iters 32 --final --runtime-flags=-DGEMV_BATCH=4 compare table continue
--layers 27 --head --iters 29 --final --no-event-timing --runtime-flags=-DGEMV_BATCH=4 table continue    # FWD_PASS
--layers 27 --head --iters 30 --final --argmax-slices 8 compare table continue    # 8 head events
--layers 27 --head --iters 31 --final --argmax-slices 8 compare table continue
--layers 27 --head --iters 32 --final --argmax-slices 8 compare table continue
--layers 27 --head --iters 29 --final --no-event-timing --argmax-slices 8 table continue    # FWD_PASS
